archetypes.name: dyn-compose-gate
archetypes.rationale: Checks the new compose-time guideline gate and durable-note freshness behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed architectural-guidelines gate from materialization through durable write and PR body compose. Focus on whether current durable notes are reused safely, assessment-required exits cannot loop incorrectly, and stale staged/drop artifacts cannot leak into shipped PR bodies. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
